quests.instruction: What color is a fire hydrant on the street corner?
quests.question: Red
quests.hint: Firefighters use this color so people notice it quickly.
quests.explanation: Yes! Fire hydrants are painted this bright color so they're easy to spot in an emergency.
quests.funFact: Firefighters can connect a hose to a hydrant like this in under a minute!

quests.instruction: What color is a pet goldfish swimming in its bowl?
quests.question: Orange
quests.hint: Think of a pumpkin or a carrot — same color!
quests.explanation: That's right! Most goldfish have shiny scales in this warm color.
quests.funFact: A goldfish's memory is much better than people used to think!

quests.instruction: What color is a classic rubber duck in the bathtub?
quests.question: Yellow
quests.hint: It's the same cheerful color as the sun.
quests.explanation: Yes! Classic rubber ducks are made in this bright, cheerful color.
quests.funFact: Thousands of rubber ducks once fell off a ship and floated across the ocean!

quests.instruction: What color is a healthy desert cactus?
quests.question: Green
quests.hint: Think of grass or a fresh leaf — same color!
quests.explanation: Correct! A healthy cactus is this color, even in the dry desert.
quests.funFact: Some cacti can store enough water inside to survive for two years!

quests.instruction: What color are the feathers of a little bluebird?
quests.question: Blue
quests.hint: The same color as a clear sky.
quests.explanation: Yes! This little bird is named after its beautiful feather color.
quests.funFact: Bluebird feathers aren't actually dyed blue — tiny structures in them bend the light!

quests.instruction: What color is grape jelly on your toast?
quests.question: Purple
quests.hint: The same rich color as an eggplant.
quests.explanation: That's right! Grape jelly is made in this deep, sweet color.
quests.funFact: People have been making fruit jelly for hundreds of years!

quests.instruction: What color are the soft petals of a peony flower?
quests.question: Pink
quests.hint: The same color as cotton candy.
quests.explanation: Yes! Peonies often bloom in this soft, pretty color.
quests.funFact: A peony flower can bloom for over 100 years if it's cared for well!

quests.instruction: What color is an acorn that fell from an oak tree?
quests.question: Brown
quests.hint: The same earthy color as chocolate.
quests.explanation: Correct! A ripe acorn's shell is this warm, earthy color.
quests.funFact: A single oak tree can drop thousands of acorns in one autumn!

quests.instruction: What color is a panther's sleek fur?
quests.question: Black
quests.hint: The same deep color as a shiny piano.
quests.explanation: Yes! A panther's fur is this deep, dark color all over.
quests.funFact: A 'black panther' is really a leopard or jaguar with extra dark fur!

quests.instruction: What color is a fresh sheet of printer paper?
quests.question: White
quests.hint: The same clean color as fresh snow.
quests.explanation: That's right! Most fresh paper is made in this bright, clean color.
quests.funFact: Paper was invented in China almost 2,000 years ago!

quests.instruction: What color is a big elephant's skin?
quests.question: Gray
quests.hint: The same color as a rainy storm cloud.
quests.explanation: Yes! Most elephants have thick, wrinkly skin in this color.
quests.funFact: An elephant's skin can be over an inch thick, but it can still feel a tiny fly land on it!

quests.instruction: What color is a ripe, crunchy bell pepper?
quests.question: Red
quests.hint: The same bright color as a fire truck.
quests.explanation: Yes! A bell pepper turns this color when it's fully ripe.
quests.funFact: A ripe red pepper actually has more vitamin C in it than an orange!

quests.instruction: What color is a construction worker's safety vest?
quests.question: Orange
quests.hint: The same bright color as a traffic cone.
quests.explanation: Correct! Safety vests are made this bright color so workers are easy to see.
quests.funFact: This bright color was chosen because it stands out against almost every background!

quests.instruction: What color is a singing canary bird?
quests.question: Yellow
quests.hint: The same bright color as a school bus.
quests.explanation: Yes! Canaries are known for their cheerful feathers in this color.
quests.funFact: Canaries were once used to help keep coal miners safe underground!

quests.instruction: What color is a neatly trimmed garden hedge?
quests.question: Green
quests.hint: The same fresh color as grass.
quests.explanation: That's right! Healthy hedges and bushes are trimmed to show off this color.
quests.funFact: Some gardeners trim hedges into fun shapes like animals!

quests.instruction: What color is a shiny sapphire gemstone?
quests.question: Blue
quests.hint: The same deep color as the ocean.
quests.explanation: Yes! Sapphires are prized for their deep, sparkling color.
quests.funFact: Sapphires are one of the hardest gemstones on Earth, second only to diamonds!

quests.instruction: What color are the petals of a violet flower?
quests.question: Purple
quests.hint: The same rich color as grape jelly.
quests.explanation: Yes! Violets are named after this beautiful color.
quests.funFact: The color name 'violet' actually comes from this very flower!

quests.instruction: What color is a classic piggy bank shaped like a pig?
quests.question: Pink
quests.hint: The same fun color as bubblegum.
quests.explanation: That's right! Piggy banks are often made in this playful color.
quests.funFact: People started saving coins in pig-shaped banks hundreds of years ago!

quests.instruction: What color is the shell of a walnut?
quests.question: Brown
quests.hint: The same earthy color as an acorn.
quests.explanation: Yes! A walnut's rough shell is this warm, earthy color.
quests.funFact: Walnuts are one of the oldest tree foods known to people!

quests.instruction: What color is a classic stick of licorice candy?
quests.question: Black
quests.hint: The same dark color as a car tire.
quests.explanation: Correct! Classic licorice candy is made in this deep, dark color.
quests.funFact: Licorice gets its flavor from the root of a plant, not from sugar alone!

quests.instruction: What color is a fluffy pet rabbit with pink eyes?
quests.question: White
quests.hint: The same soft color as a fresh cloud.
quests.explanation: Yes! Rabbits with this fur color often have pink eyes too.
quests.funFact: A rabbit's front teeth never stop growing its whole life!

quests.instruction: What color is a wild wolf's thick fur?
quests.question: Gray
quests.hint: The same color as a stone or a rainy sky.
quests.explanation: Yes! Wild wolves usually have thick fur in this color.
quests.funFact: Wolves howl to talk to each other across long distances!

quests.instruction: What color is a classic brick house?
quests.question: Red
quests.hint: The same color as a ripe tomato.
quests.explanation: That's right! Classic bricks are baked in clay ovens until they turn this color.
quests.funFact: Bricks like these have been used to build houses for over 5,000 years!

quests.instruction: What color is a bright marigold flower in the garden?
quests.question: Orange
quests.hint: The same warm color as a pumpkin.
quests.explanation: Yes! Marigolds bloom in this warm, sunny color.
quests.funFact: Marigold flowers are edible and are sometimes added to salads!

quests.instruction: What color is a classic taxi cab in a big city?
quests.question: Yellow
quests.hint: The same cheerful color as a rubber duck.
quests.explanation: Correct! Classic taxi cabs are painted this color so people can spot them easily.
quests.funFact: This taxi color was chosen because studies showed it's the easiest color to see from far away!

quests.instruction: What color is a sour lime?
quests.question: Green
quests.hint: The same fresh color as a healthy cactus.
quests.explanation: Yes! A lime's skin is this bright, fresh color.
quests.funFact: Limes were once carried on ships to help sailors stay healthy!

quests.instruction: What color are the tiny petals of a forget-me-not flower?
quests.question: Blue
quests.hint: The same soft color as a robin's egg.
quests.explanation: That's right! These tiny flowers bloom in this soft, pretty color.
quests.funFact: This flower got its sweet name from an old, romantic story!

quests.instruction: What color is a classic iris flower, the one that shares its name with part of your eye?
quests.question: Purple
quests.hint: The same deep color as a ripe plum.
quests.explanation: Yes! The classic iris flower blooms in this deep, rich color.
quests.funFact: The colored part of your eye is called an iris too, after this very flower!

quests.instruction: What color is the smooth inside of a conch shell?
quests.question: Pink
quests.hint: The same soft color as a peony petal.
quests.explanation: Yes! The inside of a conch shell often has this soft, pretty color.
quests.funFact: You can sometimes hear ocean sounds when you hold a big shell like this to your ear!

quests.instruction: What color is a freshly baked gingerbread cookie?
quests.question: Brown
quests.hint: The same warm color as a walnut shell.
quests.explanation: Correct! Gingerbread bakes into this warm, spicy color.
quests.funFact: People have baked cookies shaped like this for hundreds of years!
